## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

 DharmaNexus automatically aligns the text extensively with T 99, T 100, the *Mahāvastu-avadāna*, the individual Chinese *Yueyu jing* (T 121, aligning with SN 16.3), and various Mahāyāna and scholastic treatises including the *Śrāvakabhūmi* and *Arthaviniścayasūtra* [DharmaNexus]. In Pali literature, DharmaNexus detects significant formulaic reuse between this saṁyutta and numerous chapters of the *Aṅguttaranikāya* (particularly AN 10, AN 5, AN 3, and AN 4) as well as *Nidāna Saṁyutta* (SN 12) and *Abyākata Saṁyutta* (SN 44) [DharmaNexus].
